title: Wiladat ki khushiyaa'n manaane ke din hai
body:
WILADAT KI KHUSHYAA MANANE K DIN HAI
YAHI TO MUQADDAR BANANE KE DIN HAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
BAJUZ MAAHE SHABAAN HAIN HAR MAH PUR GHUM (2)
YAHI APNE HASNE HASAANE KE DIN HAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
BULA LAO KOI FARAZDAQ KO JAA KAR (2)
YAHI APNE SUNNE SUNAANE KE DIN HAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
ISI MAAH KO BAKSHI ZAINAB NE IZZAT (2)
YAHI UNKE DUNIYA MEIN AANE KE DIN HAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
ISI MAAH ABBAS TASHREEF LAAYE (2)
YE MASHKE SAKINA SAJAANE KE DIN HAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
ISI MEIN HUSAIN AUR QASIM BHI AAYE (2)
SAFEI'N KARBALA KI BICHHANE KE DIN HAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
CHALO TEHNIYAT KO DARE SAYYEDA PAR (2)
SHABEEHE PAYAMBAR KE AANE KE DIN HAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
ZAHOOR UNKA HOGA TO KHUSHIYAAN MILENGI (2)
MAWADDAT KI RAAHEI'N SAJAANE KE DIN HAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
BAS AB KATNE WAALI HAIN FURQAT KI RAATEI'N (2)
IMAM-E-ZAMANA KE AANE KE DIN HAIN
author: Sibte Jaffer Shaheed
